In the background, a red storage shelf is visible, stacked with translucent shoe containers, alongside a large brown paper bag placed on the floor near the wall. (2) The camera pans left to reveal another Corgi wearing a pink collar, sitting underneath a black table with pink-cushioned chairs. The person's hand moves between the two dogs, gently grabbing and petting their heads and ears while the dogs respond with mouth movements and barks. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a well-lit indoor residential or office space. (3) The owner continues the alternating petting session, frequently returning to the Corgi on the floor who remains in a submissive, belly-up position. The handheld camera movement is dynamic, following the hand's path and capturing the dogs' fur textures and excited facial expressions. The person is wearing grey joggers and an orange smartwatch band, which are visible as they sit on the floor level with the pets.
